observations.behavior: Documentation and implementation change: the CSP enforcement behavior for self-hosted installs is made report-only rather than enforced, while Cloud and hobby remain report-only; the middleware no longer checks request.user and no longer depends on HttpRequest, instead using path and settings. observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent self-hosted customers from having their pages blocked by an overly strict CSP, while still allowing Cloud and hobby to retain report-only behavior. The removal of HttpRequest dependency and the use of path and settings could simplify the middleware and reduce reliance on authentication state, potentially improving compatibility and maintainability.
